title: Getting Started with Node.js and Express
content: Node.js is an open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment. When paired with Express.js, it provides a fast and minimalist framework for building scalable RESTful APIs.
author: Alice Johnson

title: Mastering RESTful API Architecture
content: A REST API adheres to architectural constraints such as statelessness, uniform interfaces, and standard HTTP methods including GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE.
author: Bob Smith

title: Best Practices for Backend Error Handling
content: Proper error handling and meaningful HTTP status codes improve API developer experience, debugging efficiency, and client application stability.
author: Carol White
